title: Fraction representatives for the derived localization unit before model transport
statement: Let R, A, Aq, B be commutative rings in one universe, with the compatible algebra structures and derived categories in the recorded Lean signature. Let S be a submonoid of A, with Aq a localization at S. Let F: D(R) -> D(B) be any left derived extension-of-scalars functor with its universal counit. For any A-complex Q and its termwise localization unit uQ, every degree-i homology class y in F(restrict_R(Aq tensor_A Q)) has a numerator x in H^i(F(restrict_R Q)) and denominator s in S: applying H^i(F) to multiplication by algebraMap(A,Aq)(s) on the localized input sends y to H^i(F(uQ))(x). No cohomology model, tensor-coefficient action, or choice of a second derived functor occurs in this statement.

source.place: Tags 06Y6 and 0DJ8, derived change of rings and the affine cohomology localization identity

proof.text: Put D=Aq tensor_R B, with the A tensor_R B algebra structure induced by A to Aq. Obtain base-derived tensor cohomology models L for Q and K for Aq tensor_A Q from nonempty_baseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel. Only the universal derived functors, their cohomology isomorphisms and their scalar-action fields will be used.

Apply exists_baseTensorUnitCohomologyModel to L,K,uQ. This gives an ordinary A-complex C and A-linear cohomology isomorphisms e,e' identifying localizationModelMap with homology of the extension-restriction adjunction unit on C.

Prove ordinary_fractions directly. Localization flatness makes E=extendScalars(A to Aq) exact; restriction G is exact, so E followed by G preserves homology. For T=C.sc(i), ShortComplex.homologyMap_mapNatTrans writes the homology unit as e0.hom followed by the module unit on T.homology followed by e1.inv. The module unit is IsLocalizedModule S by IsLocalization.tensorProduct_isLocalizedModule (the tensor-localization assertion with M=A and N=T.homology). IsLocalizedModule.surj applied to e1.hom(y) gives x,s with s*e1.hom(y)=unit(x). Transport back through the two A-linear homology comparisons to obtain s*y=H(unit)(e0.inv(x)).

Apply ordinary_fractions to e'.hom(y) and choose the numerator e.inv(x). Injectivity and A-linearity of e'.hom, together with its commuting equation and e.hom(e.inv(x))=x, give the fraction equation in the model K. This is the private lemma model_fractions.

Let zeta:F isomorphic to L.derived and eta:L.derived isomorphic to K.derived be the universal-counit comparisons. Applying homology and the cohomologyIso fields gives B-linear isomorphisms e from H(F(Q_R)) to L.cohomology(i), and e' from H(F((Aq tensor_A Q)_R)) to K.cohomology(i). Naturality of zeta gives e' after H(F(uQ)) equal to localizationModelMap after e. Naturality of zeta composed with eta, followed by K.cohomologyIso_smul, intertwines the derived image of multiplication by algebraMap(s) with includeLeft(algebraMap(s)) on K.cohomology(i). Apply model_fractions to e'(y), take numerator e.inv(x), and use injectivity of e' to transport its equation back. Both commuting equations are proved as categorical morphism equalities before evaluating on elements.

proof_origin.place: Tags 06Y6 and 0DJ8; P2 uses the existing balanced unit model, proves ordinary localization fractions by exact homology comparison, and transports through universal-counit naturality
